name: Istoriya moego grehopadeniya: Plody nachala i kontsa
original_name: История моего грехопадения: Плоды начала и конца
source:
Your life has always been a quiet fairy tale. You live surrounded by your beloved sisters, beneath the glass canopy of a magnificent greenhouse, with kind guardians looking after you. Nothing has ever disturbed the gentle rhythm of your days.

Then comes the time of the ritual.

You have been chosen to take the place of a goddess who has passed away. The task seems simple: endure the trials and bring back the Fruits of Beginning and End.

Translated from [url=https://vk.com/wall-215668233_521]VK[/url]
translation:
你的生活向来宛如一则宁静的童话。在宏伟温室的玻璃穹顶之下，你被挚爱的姐妹们环绕，还有慈祥的监护人悉心照料着你们。从未有任何事物打破过这份温柔平缓的日常韵律。

直到仪式之刻降临。

你被选中接替一位已然陨落的女神之位。摆在面前的使命看似简单：经受住重重试炼，带回“始与终之果”。

[译自[url=https://vk.com/wall-215668233_521]VK[/url]]
